# zabbix_proxy (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Zabbix proxy by its technical name.

Attribute names match the [`zabbix_proxy`](../resources/proxy.md) resource and
are the same on every supported Zabbix version; see that page for how they map
onto the pre-7.0 and 7.0+ forms of the proxy object.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "zabbix_proxy" "existing" {
  name = "proxy-eu-west"
}

resource "zabbix_host" "example" {
  host    = "server-1.example.com"
  groups  = [zabbix_hostgroup.example.id]
  proxyid = data.zabbix_proxy.existing.id

  interface {
    type = "agent"
    ip   = "127.0.0.1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **host** (String, Deprecated) Technical name of the proxy. Renamed `name` in
  Zabbix 7.0 — use `name` instead. Exactly one of `host` or `name` must be set.
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **name** (String) Technical name of the proxy. Exactly one of `host` or
  `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- **address** (String) Address (IP or DNS name) the server connects to, passive proxies only
- **allowed_addresses** (String) Comma delimited list of addresses the proxy may connect from, active proxies only
- **description** (String) Description of the proxy
- **operating_mode** (String) How the proxy and server connect, one of: active, passive
- **port** (String) Port the server connects to, passive proxies only
- **tls_accept** (String) Encryption accepted from an active proxy, one of: unencrypted, psk, cert
- **tls_connect** (String) Encryption used when the server connects to a passive proxy, one of: unencrypted, psk, cert
- **tls_issuer** (String) Certificate issuer
- **tls_subject** (String) Certificate subject

`tls_psk_identity` and `tls_psk` are write-only in the Zabbix API and therefore
not available from this data source.
